messages:
alex: quick pulse — who can own the 11:00 PDT slot today? aiming for small config + embeddings model bump. need smoke, perf check, rollback ready. cc @kevin for DB migration sign-off
mira: I can take it. will be oncall. smoke checklist green if we stick to 10m canary
sam: thx mira. quick q — is there a migration? i thought embeddings schema change was noop
alex: no full migration; just index refresh. sam, we still need to warm caches. plan:
```
- deploy model v3.1 (quantized)
- run smoke: /ops/smoke.sh --quick
- run perf probe: curl -sS https://perf-redwood/api/probe
- rollback: pin traffic back to v3.0
```
kevin: saw the plan. lgtm for index refresh, but please ensure backup snapshot before deploy (db snapshot ok)
mira: noted — I'll create snapshot at 10:30 and share link
lan: I'll monitor latency and token-ops during canary. if p90 > 250ms i'll call rollback
devops-bot: pipeline triggered: release/2024-03-12/slot-11. Status: queued
alex: thanks all. mira, once snapshot done please drop a thumbs here and we can start canary at 11:00
mira: snapshot done: https://snapshots.internal/shot-20240312-1032 :thumbsup:
devops-bot: deploy started: job 98765. canary instances: 2/2
sam: quick CR ping — I added a fallback to client to degrade to smaller context if kv cache misses spike
kevin: holding rollback permission until 11:20 (give canary 20m). call me in thread to rollback
lan: seeing slight p95 bump on canary but within threshold. holding.
mira: canary stable. promoting to full at 11:25 unless objections
alex: promote at 11:25. postmortem note: watch embedding recall. ping if regression
mira: promoted. full deploy in progress.
devops-bot: deploy complete: success. rollout 100% in 10m. logs: /deploy/logs/98765
sam: awesome — I'll run smoke harness now
lan: after smoke run, all KPIs within baseline. :party_parrot:
kevin: closing rollback window. good job team.
alex: thanks everyone — adding a short blurb to release notes and closing out.
